# ledger_label_assignment (Resource)

One label put on one object by the person. Labels are many-valued: an object can carry several, each its own resource. **Destroying** it takes the label off and Ledger records that the person removed it, so rules and models do not add it back; put it back by applying the resource again.

Import with `<object_type>/<object_id>/<label_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Labels are many-valued: one resource per label per object.
resource "ledger_label_assignment" "rent_reviewed" {
  object_type = "commitment"
  object_id   = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA"
  label_id    = ledger_label.reviewed.id
}

# A merchant takes labels too (administrator-only merchants grants).
resource "ledger_label_assignment" "grocer_reviewed" {
  object_type = "merchant"
  object_id   = ledger_merchant.grocer.id
  label_id    = ledger_label.reviewed.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label_id` (String) The identifier of an active label. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `object_id` (String) The Ledger identifier of the object. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `object_type` (String) The kind of object: `transaction`, `commitment`, `account` or `merchant`. A merchant is addressed by its record identifier (`ledger_merchant`) and needs an API token with the administrator-only `merchants:read` and `merchants:write` grants, because merchant names derive from bank text; an archived merchant takes no new assignment. Buckets never hold merchants. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<object_type>/<object_id>/<label_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <object_type>/<object_id>/<label_id>
terraform import ledger_label_assignment.rent_reviewed commitment/01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA/01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNB
terraform import ledger_label_assignment.grocer_reviewed merchant/01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNC/01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNB
```
